The '''C-6 battery''' was a small [[Battery/Legends|battery]] manufactured by [[Atgar SpaceDefense Corporation/Legends|Atgar SpaceDefense Corporation]]. It was installed in Atgar's [[1.4 FD P-Tower/Legends|1.4 FD P-Tower]], where it provided enough power for the [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] to fire eight shots.<ref name="EGWT" />
